== History == The company was started as CAT Computer Services (P) Ltd, a computer service centre, in 1995. The company "CAT Computer Services (P) Ltd" was rebranded to Quick Heal Technologies Limited by Kailash Katkar and Sanjay Katkar in 2007.{{cite news|title=Quick Heal: Viral Success|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/12-hidden-gems/quick-heal-viral-success/34063/1|access-date=2 December 2016|agency=Forbes}} In 2010, Quick Heal received an investment of [[Indian rupee|₹]]60 [[crore]] from [[Sequoia Capital]].{{Cite web|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2010-08-18/news/27584689_1_security-software-software-provider-sequoia-capital-india|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140322010104/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2010-08-18/news/27584689_1_security-software-software-provider-sequoia-capital-india|url-status=dead|archive-date=22 March 2014|title=Sequoia Cap invests Rs 60 cr in Quick Heal|access-date=2016-08-29}} A new branch office was opened in [[Madurai]], [[Tamil Nadu]]. In 2012, offices were opened in [[Japan]] and the US, and in 2013, offices were opened in [[Africa]] and [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]]. In 2016, Quick Heal Technologies acquired an IT security firm Junco Technologies to launch Seqrite Services.{{cite news |last= Sangani |first=Priyanka |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/internet/quick-heal-acquires-junco-technologies-launches-cyber-security-arm/articleshow/52865717.cms |title=Quick Heal acquires Junco Technologies, launches cyber security arm |work=[[The Economic Times]] |date=2016-06-22 |access-date=2016-12-13 }} In 2016, Quick Heal Technologies launched its [[Initial public offering|IPO]] which valued the company at a market value of [[Indian rupee|₹]]1,500 crore.{{Cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/Money/Qv8lw8MdprqDIVcpAuv1GP/Quick-Heal-Technologies-IPO-to-open-on-8-February.html|title=Quick Heal Technologies IPO to open on 8 February|last=Doshi|first=Ankit|date=2016-02-02|website=Livemint|language=en|access-date=2020-04-21}} == References == {{Reflist|2}} ==External links== * {{official|http://www.quickheal.com}} {{Antivirus software}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Quick Heal}} [[Category:Antivirus software]] [[Category:Computer security software companies]] [[Category:Windows security software]] [[Category:macOS security software]] [[Category:Companies based in Pune]] [[Category:Software companies established in 1993]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Software companies of India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1993]] [[Category:1993 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract:
Quick Heal is an Indian multinational cybersecurity software company, headquartered in Pune. The company develops security software for consumers, servers, cloud computing environments and small and medium enterprises. Its enterprise product offerings operate under the brand name Seqrite.
Quick Heal Technologies Ltd is listed on BSE and NSE.
